seo.title: HabitRise | Build the System — The 21-Day 6 AM Habit Challenge
seo.description: Rise at 6 and keep the streak. HabitRise is a 21-day live habit challenge with daily 6 AM Zoom sessions, the S.A.V.E.R.S morning routine and a private Skool community.

hero.text: HabitRise is a 21-day live habit challenge. Show up at 6 AM, tick off your six morning habits, and let a community of early risers keep you honest.

tracker.title: Your 21-day streak
tracker.hint: Tap a day — this is how members track their mornings.
tracker.ariaLabel: 21-day tracker, tap a day to tick it

how.title: One morning at HabitRise.
how.text: Three things happen every day for 21 days. That's the whole system.

cards.title: Join the live session
cards.text: A focused 6 AM session with the founder — one topic a day, from purpose to deep work.

cards.title: Do your six habits
cards.text: Silence, Affirmations, Visualisation, Exercise, Reading, Scribing — the S.A.V.E.R.S routine.

cards.title: Check in with the crew
cards.text: Post your morning in the Skool community. Earn points, climb levels, get noticed.

program.title: 21 days, 3 levels.
program.text: Each week unlocks the next. Open to everyone aged 12 and above.

weeks.title: Foundation
weeks.text: Discover your purpose, own your life and design your future from the ground up.

weeks.title: Build the System
weeks.text: Destroy fear, eliminate procrastination and install a daily power routine.

weeks.title: Complete Transformation
weeks.text: Master focus, communication and uniqueness — and celebrate your new self.

community.title: Your 6 AM club lives on Skool.
community.text: Every member gets the private HabitRise group: daily check-ins, the classroom, the live calendar and a leaderboard.
community.groupText: Build discipline with people who wake up when you do. Live sessions every morning at 6:00 AM IST, lessons and replays in the classroom, and a feed full of early risers.

stories.title: Straight from the group chat.
stories.text: What members say once the 21 days are done.

items.name: Praveen Kumar
items.quote: I used to scroll till 2 AM and wake up at noon. After 21 days with HabitRise, I wake at 6 AM without an alarm. My CGPA went from 6.8 to 8.4 in one semester.

items.name: Divya Ramesh
items.quote: The accountability is what changed everything. Knowing the group was showing up at 6 AM made me show up too. The SAVERS routine is now non-negotiable for me.

items.name: Arjun Nair
items.quote: As a founder I thought I had discipline. HabitRise showed me the difference between being busy and being intentional. My mornings now belong to me, not my inbox.

items.name: Sneha Patel
items.quote: I was stuck in procrastination for years. The visualisation and scribing habits gave me clarity I had never felt. I finally started the side project I kept postponing.

items.name: Karthik Subramanian
items.quote: The community kept me going on days I wanted to quit. By day 21 the habits felt automatic. This is the most practical self-improvement system I have tried.

items.name: Meera Iyer
items.quote: I have bought many courses that I never finished. HabitRise is the first one where the daily live sessions actually made me complete it. Worth every rupee.

items.q: What time are the live sessions?
items.a: Every day at 6:00 AM IST for all 21 days. Starting before the world wakes up is the whole point.
Anyone aged 12 and above — students, working professionals, entrepreneurs and career switchers all go through the same system together.
There's a special price for students and a standard price for working professionals — one-time, for all 21 days. See the Pricing page for the current early-bird prices.
Fill in the short registration form, then you'll be taken to a secure Razorpay page to pay by UPI, card or net banking.

items.q: When do I get access to the community?
items.a: Once your payment is confirmed you'll receive an email with your Skool community link within 24–48 hours.
Six morning habits — Silence, Affirmations, Visualisation, Exercise, Reading and Scribing. You'll learn each one during the program and install the full routine by Day 13.

final.title: Day 1 starts
final.text: Your streak is one tap away. Build the system.
